read.thesis: Steel and mining major; 4Q25 EBITDA up 5.6% q/q to $1.6bn, but FY25 EBITDA fell 7.3% and net debt rose to $7.9bn after $1.9bn M&A, with EU trade protection (TRQ, CBAM) the key supply-side hope.

utilisation.quote: Crude steel production reached 1.8Mt in 4Q 2025, an 8.5% increase compared with 1.7Mt in 3Q 2025

capex.quote: The Company's capex in 2026 is projected to be within the range of $4.5-$5.0bn

triggers.label: EU TRQ cuts imports ~10Mt
triggers.quote: It is estimated that this can reduce imports of flat and long products by ~10Mt, which would support higher domestic capacity utilization

triggers.label: 4Q working capital release $2.4bn
triggers.quote: Net cash provided by operating activities during 4Q 2025 amounted to $3.0 billion and includes a $2.4 billion release of working capital.

guidance.metric: World ex-China apparent steel demand growth FY2026
guidance.quote: The Company expects world ex-China apparent steel demand to grow by +2% in FY 2026.
The Company's capex in 2026 is projected to be within the range of $4.5-$5.0bn
12M 2026 depreciation is estimated at approximately $3.0 billion.
Recently completed and ongoing projects are expected to add a further $1.6bn of EBITDA potential ($0.7bn in 2026 and $0.9bn from 2027 onward).
the Board proposes to increase the annual base dividend to shareholders to $0.60/sh in FY 2026 (from $0.55/sh in FY 2025)

red_flags.label: FY25 FCF only $0.4bn; net debt up to $7.9bn
red_flags.quote: Following shareholder returns of $0.7 billion and M&A of $1.9 billion ($0.2 billion in cash plus debt consolidated), net debt increased to $7.9 billion

red_flags.label: Europe 4Q ASP and volume down
red_flags.quote: mainly reflecting a 6.1% decline in steel shipment volume
